effect_description_eng:
＜Digisorption -2＞ (When one of your Digimon would digivolve into this card from your hand, you may suspend 1 of your Digimon to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.)
[When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's Tamers.
[All Turns] Your opponent's Tamers don't unsuspend.
